steps.description: Clone the R2E-Gym repository, install the uv package manager, create a virtual environment, and install dependencies (git clone git@github.com:agentica-project/R2E-Gym.git; cd R2E-Gym; curl -LsSf https://astral.sh/uv/install.sh | sh; uv venv; source .venv/bin/activate; uv sync && uv pip install -e .).

Start the VLLM server serving agentica-org/DeepSWE-Preview with tensor parallelism across 8 GPUs and wait for it to fully load (VLLM_ALLOW_LONG_MAX_MODEL_LEN=1 vllm serve agentica-org/DeepSWE-Preview --tensor-parallel-size 8 --max-model-len $MAX_CONTEXT_LEN --enable_prefix_caching).
Run the DeepSWE agent evaluation on the R2E-Gym/SWE-Bench-Verified dataset via src/r2egym/agenthub/run/edit.py runagent_multiple, producing trajectory results.
Convert the trajectory results to SWE-Bench submission format via src/r2egym/agenthub/trajectory/create_swebench_submission.py.
steps.source: DEEPSWE_REPRODUCTION.MD Evaluation with SWE-Bench Harness step 4

steps.description: Run the official SWE-Bench evaluation harness (python -m swebench.harness.run_evaluation --dataset_name princeton-nlp/SWE-bench_Verified --predictions_path outputs/swebench_submission.json ...) to produce pass/fail results and summary statistics.
